notes: Volume: general scrutiny of the 24 circunscripciones departamentales (pp.4-25; p.4 is the provisional 1.a scrutiny, pp.6-7 complementary final tables for 1.a and 2.a, p.25 complementary final table for 22.a, p.22 is the repeated 18.a election of 14 Mar 1926), a table of registered voters and non-voters by department (p.26, used for national registered 302,142 'Total de la República' and to resolve unclear inscritos in headers), and the list of elected deputies (pp.27-30). For groupings with complementary elections the final totals are transcribed; the provisional figures are summarized in notes. No grouping prints cast, valid or null totals except a few department-level blank/void counts; registered is the sum of department inscritos printed in each heading. Lists are numbered lists without party labels except 18.a. Many cells are poorly printed; where a cell was illegible the value fixed by printed totals or proclamation text is used and noted. Election day from the p.26 heading.

contests.title: 1.a Circunscripción Departamental
contests.notes: Final figures from the CUADRO COMPLEMENTARIO (p.6): TOTAL GENERAL = votes of the 22 November election plus the complementary election of 14 March 1926 ordered by the Tribunal Calificador; proclamation dated 23 Apr 1926. The provisional general scrutiny of 22 November alone is on p.4 (Lista 1: 1,886; Lista 2: 329; Lista 3: 130; Lista 4: 911; Lista 5: 598; Lista 6: 302; provisionally elected Cuadra, Cuevas, de la Maza, Cuadra Lazo). registered = sum of department inscritos printed in header (Pisagua 1,054; Tarapacá 7,552). No cast/valid/null printed.

contests.title: 2.a Circunscripción Departamental

The provisional 22 November scrutiny is on p.5 (poor print). registered = sum of department inscritos printed in the p.7 header (Tocopilla 2,885; El Loa 1,554; Antofagasta 7,445; Taltal 1,729) (summed by transcriber). No cast/valid/null printed. Some candidates stand on two lists (Guzmán, Reyes Díaz, Santos Córdova, Fuenzalida, Bahamondes). In Lista 4 the typed first name of Santos Córdova is struck through and 'José Santos' handwritten.

contests.title: Quinta Circunscripción Departamental
contests.notes: registered = sum of department inscritos in header (Petorca 1,272; Ligua 1,161; Putaendo 1,124; San Felipe 2,046; Los Andes 2,457), summed by transcriber. Observaciones printed: in the Putaendo departmental record one vote was not counted and two blank votes appeared; in Los Andes eight blank votes were recorded; in Petorca four votes were not counted and one was blank. Lista 1 has no Petorca/Ligua subtotals printed.

contests.title: 6.a Circunscripción Departamental
contests.notes: Very poor print on p.10; many cells read with help of the proclamation text. registered = sum of department inscritos in header (Valparaíso 26,081, unclear in header, confirmed by the inscritos table on p.26; Casablanca 786; Quillota 3,045; Limache 2,690), summed by transcriber. No cast/valid/null printed. Lista 5 no-preference figure read as 305 (the text says 305; the table cell looks like 306). Lista 15: Montané 2,827, Ríos 2,479 and Oms Lock 1,566 reconstructed from the text's arithmetic and department cells (table cells blurred); Ugalde 803 and Bravo 1,262 as given in the text. Lista 16: cells largely illegible; preferences as read sum to 2,563 against the printed list total 2,634 (unresolved). Lista 7 total read 181 (department cells as read give 171). Lista 11 total read 435 (department cells as read give 434). Some names are uncertain because of the print: 'Olline', 'Tul…' (Lista 9), 'Baeza Cruzat' (Lista 12, could read 'Crumt'). Cociente seats: 1 to Lista 5, 9 to Lista 15, 1 to Lista 16.

contests.title: Séptima Circunscripción Departamental
contests.notes: Heading reads 'ELIGE 18 DIPUTADOS' (the volume's index on p.3 prints 16). Poor print; small figures uncertain. registered from header (Departamento de Santiago: 55,884 inscriptos; third digit could be 9). No cast/valid/null printed. Seats: cociente gives 3 to Lista 15, 4 to Lista 26 and 11 to Lista 27; Lista 15 had only one candidate (Jorge Alessandri Rodríguez) and its two surplus seats were awarded by the Tribunal Calificador (sentence of 12 Feb) to Rafael Silva Lastra (Lista 26) and Rogelio Ugarte (Lista 28); seats below count those awards on the receiving lists. Observación printed: the sentence ordered 6 votes added to César Roa Urzúa (not counted in Providencia), giving him 1,072; the table keeps the original figure. Unresolved sums: Lista 7 preferences as read (1+28+7+9+7+0=52) vs printed total read as 52/53; Lista 19 preferences as read (21+232+208+22=483) vs printed 476, middle cells blurred; Lista 27 preferences as read sum 22,700 vs printed 22,714 (several cells blurred; Errázuriz 2,108 and Vergara 2,443 per table/text); Lista 28: no-preference read 761 and Ugarte Bustamante 116 (blurred, chosen to fit the printed 1,205). Lista 24 no-preference read 95 (could be 96). First name of first preference in Lista 13 illegible.

Lista 1 total read 243 (as in the cuociente table; the table cell looks like 242).

Lista 3: printed preferences + no-preference (64+2,453+830+1,826+704 = 5,877) do not match the printed list total 5,873 (also 5.873 in the cuociente table); the department subtotals as printed also disagree. Lista 1 'No obtuvo votos' (no figures printed; recorded as 0). Lista 3 gets 5 seats, Lista 4 one (Fidel 2.o Estay Cortés, by relative majority). Proclamation 12 Feb 1926.

contests.title: 18.a Circunscripción Departamental
contests.notes: Figures are the 'Cuadro de escrutinio definitivo de la elección ordenada repetir por fallo del Tribunal Calificador y verificada el 14 de Marzo de 1926'; proclamation 26 Apr 1926. No figures of the original 22 November vote are printed for this grouping. registered = sum of department inscritos in header (Arauco 827 (unclear in header, read from the inscritos table on p.26); Lebu 2,633; Cañete 1,428), summed by transcriber. No cast/valid/null printed. Lista 1 carried a declared 'preferencia inalterable', so Morales Vivanco was elected as first candidate. Lista 6: Ríos total read 850 (cell 550/850; department cells give 850; fits list total). Lists 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 'No obtuvo votos' (recorded as 0).

contests.title: 22.a Circunscripción Departamental
contests.notes: Final figures from the 'Cuadro complementario' (p.25): TOTAL = 22 November votes + the complementary election of 14 March 1926 ordered by the Tribunal Calificador (Calle-Calle). The provisional 22 November scrutiny is on p.23 (there Lista 2 = 1,099, Lista 7 = 6,920, Lista 8 = 3,093, presumptive proclamation). In the complementary column the figures 261 and 157 are printed one row high; the TOTAL column assigns them to Espejo Pando (926+261 = 1,187) and Acharán Arce (1,048+157 = 1,205), as does the text. The 22 November column on p.25 prints Lista 7's sum as 5,920 (its rows add to 6,920). registered = sum of department inscritos in header (Villarrica 4,187; Valdivia 8,128; La Unión 2,624; Río Bueno 1,999; La Unión and Río Bueno as on p.25 and the p.26 inscritos table; p.26 prints Valdivia 8,129), summed by transcriber. No cast/valid/null printed. Proclamation dated 7 Mar 1926 as printed. Seats: 5 Lista 7, 2 Lista 8.

Lista 5 printed 1,242; Rosales 755 (cell blurred, fits). All four seats to Lista 4.

contests.title: 24.a Circunscripción Departamental

No cast/valid/null printed. All four seats to Lista 1.
